listedEpisodes.title: James Earl Jones Visits Hooper's Store
listedEpisodes.serviceLabel: 1. James Earl Jones Visits Hooper's Store
listedEpisodes.description: Big Bird and Mr. Hooper get starstruck when beloved actor James Earl Jones stops by. Later, Bert reminds Ernie what he needs to bring to the laundromat.

matchBasis.title: James Earl Jones visits Hooper’s Store

listedEpisodes.title: Big Bird Becomes a Superhero
listedEpisodes.description: Big Bird imagines he's a superhero and searches for anybody who might need his help while Telly learns how the bus stop is really supposed to work.

listedEpisodes.title: Oscar Goes to Space
listedEpisodes.description: When a trash can from outer space suddenly crash-lands on Sesame Street, Oscar meets fellow grouch Othmar, who blasts both of them to the moon and back.

listedEpisodes.title: Goodbye, Mr. Hooper
listedEpisodes.description: Ernie directs a play about emotions while Grover and actress Madeline Kahn echo each other in a song. Later, Big Bird copes with losing a close friend.

listedEpisodes.title: The Adults Meet Snuffy
listedEpisodes.description: With Elmo's help, Big Bird makes a plan for all of the grown-ups on Sesame Street to finally meet his friend Mr. Snuffleupagus face-to-face.

listedEpisodes.title: Maria and Luis Get Married
listedEpisodes.description: Wedding bells are ringing all throughout Sesame Street as Elmo, Telly and the rest of the gang get ready for Maria and Luis's special day!

listedEpisodes.title: The Martians Visit Sesame Street
listedEpisodes.description: The Yip-Yip Martians visit Sesame Street, looking for food and observing how humans show they care. Later, Zoe explains why she feels proud.

listedEpisodes.title: Elmo's Dream
listedEpisodes.description: Elmo feels angry after a strange dream where more than one Elmo shows up on Sesame Street, saying and doing all of the same things he does.

listedEpisodes.title: Snuffy Takes Tap
listedEpisodes.description: Mr. Snuffleupagus tries telling Big Bird why he's sad after taking tap-dancing lessons. Actress Jodie Foster gives Telly some acting direction.

listedEpisodes.title: Slimey Returns From the Moon
listedEpisodes.description: Oscar and the gang get ready to welcome Slimey and his worm friends back to Earth after their trip through outer space.

listedEpisodes.title: The BubbleFest
listedEpisodes.description: How do you blow a bubble? And what's the perfect mix of bubble solution? Elmo, Abby and pals have a blast while they experiment and learn all about it.

listedEpisodes.title: Elmo & The Monarch Butterfly
listedEpisodes.description: Flap, flutter and fly! To make a new friend, Elmo goes through the stages of turning into a butterfly and learns fascinating facts about insects.

listedEpisodes.title: The Good Sport
listedEpisodes.description: After playing several rounds of "Hot Potato," Elmo learns what it takes to be a good sport when he finds out he might have hurt Abby's feelings.

listedEpisodes.title: Afraid of the Bark
listedEpisodes.description: Wait for a sniff — and even a friendly lick! Elmo shows Zoe how to say hello to dogs so she can feel less scared whenever she's around them.

listedEpisodes.title: Sesame Street-O-Saurus
listedEpisodes.description: No dinosaur bones, no problem! After digging to find fossils, Rosita and Elmo help paleontologist Grover build a dino model out of random objects.

listedEpisodes.title: Great Vibrations
listedEpisodes.description: What instrument will Abby choose to play? She tries out a violin, a trombone and the timpani drums while learning how vibrations make musical sounds.

listedEpisodes.title: Firefly Show
listedEpisodes.description: The sun is setting, and the crickets are chirping. But before night falls, Telly and Baby Bear only want to do one thing: catch a firefly.

listedEpisodes.title: Big Bird's Nest Sale
listedEpisodes.description: Big Bird's beloved teddy bear, Radar, has gone missing! Snuffleupagus comes along to track it down after selling some old toys from Big Bird's nest.

listedEpisodes.title: Grandparents Celebration
listedEpisodes.description: Disappointed that his grandparents will miss a big party, Elmo still finds a way to have fun while meeting the family members of his friends.

listedEpisodes.title: The Princess Story
listedEpisodes.description: A princess, a dragon… and a pogo stick? Rosita, Abby and Zoe share their ideas while making up their own magical princess adventure story together.
